measurement.method: The current .next build is served with next start, or an existing server is selected with PERFORMANCE_BASE_URL; each route is loaded in a fresh Chromium context with reduced motion. Budgets compare encoded JS, document and font bytes plus post-load DOM element count.
measurement.decision: These are regression guardrails for representative routes, not Core Web Vitals or a production SLA. Re-measure on a modest device before changing SSR boundaries or removing editorial content.
